methodology.design: Two fresh isolated subagents on the identical underlying model audited the same unseen 3-file Node.js service (4 primary bugs + 2 safe guarded decoys, zero hint comments). ground-truth.json was written only after both arms completed.
methodology.control_isolation: Restricted to reading only examples/eval-suite/order-worker/{store.js,server.js,reconciler.js}; no skill files accessed.
methodology.treatment_isolation: Instructed to follow skills/chaos-audit/SKILL.md and validators; blocked from reading examples/sample-audit-output/, examples/vulnerable-checkout/, or case-study directories.

control_without_skill.notes: Single-pass review spotted all 4 primary bugs plus 6 secondary defects and verified safe concurrency/timeout guards informally in ad-hoc console scripts (one hung script terminated manually).

validator_outputs.fault_ledger: VALID fault-ledger: 16 unit(s), coverage=100% (covered=2, candidate=14, blocked=0, planned=0)

treatment_with_chaos_audit.notes: Coverage Critic and 6-phase loop uncovered +7 additional confirmed failure modes (hung dispatchPayout starving healthy payouts, non-scalar orderId bypassing POST /cancel Set.has/=== dedup, 4 MiB inbound/outbound HTTP buffering, negative/NaN webhook points, post-disconnect store mutations) while formally disproving 3 false-positive candidates/sub-claims and shipping 20 repeatable node --test suites.
